title: Zarankiewicz Problem
exact_target: Determine the greatest number of edges between two prescribed vertex classes when no chosen s vertices in the first class and t in the second are all joined to each other.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1427 (GRAPH-040). CC BY 4.0.
Vladimir Nikiforov, A Contribution to the Zarankiewicz Problem, arXiv:0903.5350v1 (2009), abstract and section “The matrix Zarankiewicz problem”, pages 1--2.
